_provenance.description: Registry of published metallo-cofactor parameter sources for FRUTON. Each entry documents where to fetch the frcmod / mol2 / lib bundle. FRUTON does NOT ship these files (license constraints + sizes) but the pipeline emits the reference in the audit CSV so the user knows exactly which source to consult.
research_sources_consulted: Björnsson group / ASH docs for FeMo-co (PMC8908755)

HEM_bis_His.notes: hemall provides separate parameter blocks for oxidised vs reduced; user must pick at build time

HEM_his_only.citation: Giammona DA, PhD thesis UC Davis (1984)

HEC_covalent.notes: CXXCH motif detection: 2 Cys residues within 2.5 Å of heme CAB and CAC → thioether covalent. Both Cys must be CYX-analog with heme-linked topology. FRUTON auto-detects + emits CYM override with method='hem_cxxch_patch'.

HEA_CcO.reference: Johansson 2016 heme a / heme a3 / CuA / CuB
HEA_CcO.notes: Complete active site parameters including CuB-heme a3 bridging

states_supported: Compound I Fe(IV)=O porphyrin cation radical
HEM_P450_cys_thiolate.notes: Four separate frcmod+mol2 sets; user picks state via FRUTON_HEME_STATE env var or paper evidence. Cys ligand becomes CYM.

HEM_peroxidase_cpd_I_II.reference: Shahrokh Cpd I / II as starting template
HEM_peroxidase_cpd_I_II.notes: MANUAL_REVIEW — Cys→His axial substitution needed; validate Fe=O bond length 1.76-1.87 Å against paper

SF4_4Fe4S.citation: Carvalho ATP, Swart M. JCIM 54:613 (2014) doi:10.1021/ci400718m
SF4_4Fe4S.notes: Bonded model with Seminario force constants from broken-symmetry DFT. 4× CYM anchors required. Per-redox-state frcmod: FRUTON emits with default redox_state='2+' unless paper says otherwise.

FES_2Fe2S.reference: Carvalho & Swart 2014 (Cys4) OR nitrobenzene dioxygenase set (Rieske 2Cys+2His)
FES_2Fe2S.notes: TWO variants: (a) Cys4 (standard ferredoxin/adrenodoxin) → Carvalho-Swart; (b) Rieske (2Cys + 2His) → Molina-Molina custom set. Auto-detect Rieske: FES + 2 His within 2.6 Å of Fe.

CFN_FeMoCo.reference: no static frcmod available — Björnsson group QM/MM only
CFN_FeMoCo.notes: FeMo-cofactor of nitrogenase. NO reliable static MM parameter set exists. Route MUST be MANUAL_REVIEW or QM/MM. FRUTON emits LOW confidence + suggests exclusion from pure-MM benchmark.

FEO_mononuclear.notes: Not a real cluster; single Fe treated as ion with 12-6-4 LJ nonbonded
